name: Native scatter result acknowledgement and two-turn world reward site

condition.code:
local flow=ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow and ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.Get('native-scatter-flow')
local state=ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption and ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption.GetState()
local tx=state and state.Transactions['native-scatter-flow']
if not flow or flow.Phase~='RESULT' or not tx or tx.Status~='COMPLETE' then return false end
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do
 if work.Source.Index==2 then
  local slot=work.TargetSlot
  local city=slot and CityManager.GetCityAt(slot.X,slot.Y)
  return city and city:GetOwner()==slot.Owner and city:GetID()==slot.City and city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(slot.Building,slot.Slot)==2
 end
end
return false

steps.code:
local panel=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlow_UI)
assert(panel.Open() and not Controls.Panel:IsHidden(),'scatter result panel did not open')
local view=panel.GetView()
assert(view.phase=='RESULT' and view.visible and #view.rows>0,'scatter result rows not published')
assert(not Controls.ConfirmButton:IsHidden() and not Controls.ConfirmButton:IsDisabled(),'scatter result acknowledgement unavailable')
Controls.ConfirmButton:DoLeftClick()
return 'human acknowledged real scatter result panel'

local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local id='native-scatter-flow'
local flow=assert(F.Get(id))
assert(flow.Phase=='DONE' and flow.AcknowledgedTurn and F.GetPending(1)==nil,'scatter result was not acknowledged')
local world=assert(F.GetWorld(id..':native-work:2'))
assert(world.AssetID=='native-work:2' and world.Status=='WAIT_SITE','scatter world reward not queued')
local tx=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[id])
assert(tx.Status=='COMPLETE' and #A.NativeWorkLocations(2)==1 and A.NativeWorkLocations(2)[1].Owner==62,'original work changed before world reward')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_WORLD_QUEUED] status='..world.Status..' due='..tostring(world.DueTurn)..' now='..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn())
return 'scatter Flow DONE; world reward awaits its scheduled turn'

local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
F.Tick()
local world=assert(F.GetWorld('native-scatter-flow:native-work:2'))
print('[JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_WORLD_AFTER_TURNS] status='..world.Status..' due='..tostring(world.DueTurn)..' now='..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn())
return 'product world scheduler checked after two real turns'

condition.code:
local world=ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow and ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.GetWorld('native-scatter-flow:native-work:2')
if not world or world.Status~='WAIT_CLEAR' then return false end
local plot=Map.GetPlotByIndex(world.Site)
return plot and plot:GetImprovementType()==world.Improvement

steps.code:
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local world=assert(F.GetWorld('native-scatter-flow:native-work:2'))
assert(world.Status=='WAIT_CLEAR' and world.Kind=='ITEM' and world.AssetID=='native-work:2','original native reward site not ready')
local plot=assert(Map.GetPlotByIndex(world.Site))
assert(plot:GetImprovementType()==world.Improvement,'native reward improvement not on actual plot')
local carrier=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local work=A.NativeWorkLocations(2)
assert(#work==1 and work[1].Owner==carrier.Free and work[1].X==carrier.X and work[1].Y==carrier.Y
 and work[1].Building==carrier.Building and work[1].Slot==carrier.Slot,'original work left Free Cities before reward')
local target=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_FLOW')).HumanSlot
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(target.X,target.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==target.Owner and A.CityAssets(city).BUILDING_TEMPLE.Works[target.Slot]==-1,'human recovery Temple occupied before reward')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_REWARD_READY] site='..world.Site..' improvement='..world.Improvement..' due='..world.DueTurn)
return 'two-turn original work world reward site physically ready'
